name: Config error: a wrong-typed field outranks an invalid storage_mode value
description: Layer precedence: when a config has BOTH a wrong-TYPED root field and an invalid storage_mode VALUE, all three runtimes must report the type error. pine-go does so because encoding/json fails the whole unmarshal before any value check runs; the other two must place their whitelist after every root type check. This pins a gap that review found in the fix for another gap: moving pine-cpp's whitelist to parse time (so it would outrank operator errors) put it BETWEEN the storage_mode and log_prefix reads, so pine-cpp reported the value error where pine-go and pine-java reported log_prefix's type error — java != cpp, the one pairing that is supposed to be aligned. Neither the adjacent-pair ordering tests nor the other precedence fixture caught it: both use two wrong-TYPED fields, so they never mix the two layers. 注意 `wrapping_exact` 是**包含**匹配（`05-error-parity.sh` 用 `grep -qF`），不是相等匹配：它钉住的是消息**前缀**，某一方在末尾**追加**内容不会让它变红——实测给 pine-go 的文案加 " (see docs)" 后 section 05 仍 35/35 全绿。所以这条 fixture 钉的是「前缀一致」，不是完整的字节对等；中段改词会红（已验证），尾部追加不会。

expected_error.wrapping_exact: pine: config error: config field "log_prefix" must be a string
